$comment: Fixtures the Skor Kahini agent will trade and the score attestor will attest. The eventKey each market is keyed by is DERIVED from these fields (see agents/src/agents/score-oracle/consensus.ts, canonicalFixtureString) rather than assigned, so anyone can recompute it and check that a market points at the fixture it claims to. kickoff is REQUIRED for unplayed fixtures: the seeder closes a score market at kickoff, because a market still open after the whistle can be staked risk-free by anyone who looks up the score.

fixtures.question: Arsenal vs Chelsea (Premier League, 2026-09-06): will Arsenal win? Settled by agreement between independent public score APIs; if they disagree the market voids and everyone is refunded.
Everton vs Manchester United (Premier League, 2026-09-06): will the match finish with 3 or more total goals? Settled by agreement between independent public score APIs.

Liverpool vs Fulham (Premier League, 12 Sep 2026, 14:00 UTC): will Liverpool win? Trading closes at kickoff. Settled only when independent public score APIs agree on the exact final scoreline; if they disagree the market voids and everyone is refunded.
Sunderland vs Arsenal (Premier League, 12 Sep 2026, 19:00 UTC): will Arsenal win away? Trading closes at kickoff. Settled only when independent public score APIs agree on the exact final scoreline.

Manchester United vs Manchester City (Premier League, 13 Sep 2026, 15:30 UTC): will the derby finish with 3 or more total goals? Trading closes at kickoff. Settled only when independent public score APIs agree on the exact final scoreline.
